doc: One cell of a plan's shape (design/planner.md, What a plan holds): only the village's own cells; everything open passes to a plotter.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Ground height, metres, in 5 cm steps.

fields.name: use
fields.doc: What it is: a building's plot, a road, water, a waterfront's plot, the settlement's wall, a gate (an entrance or exit, in a wall or at the road's end), open (unreserved: the plotter's), or the keep's wall. A wall is a tile: what stands on it is the wall system's.

fields.name: road
fields.doc: Its road class, where it is a road or gate.

fields.name: plot
fields.doc: The plot it belongs to (building, road, waterfront, or water), or -1.
